description: Schema registry — index of all schemas used by the EVVO Harness and their versions. Provides traceability for schema evolution.

entries.title: Input Schema v0.2 — Normalized VAPT Finding
entries.description: The input schema defines the structure of a normalized VAPT finding that enters the review pipeline. It includes 16 required fields: schema_version, finding_id, title, severity, affected_targets, affected_user_roles, cwe_id, cvss, impact, observation, evidence, recommendation, retest, references, source, governance.
entries.action: Validate finding against input_schema.json. Reject if schema_version is not '0.2'.

entries.title: Output Schema v0.1 — Structured Review Result
entries.description: The output schema defines the structure of the review result. It includes review_status, classification, completeness_review, evidence_review, severity_review, cvss_review, cwe_review, impact_review, recommendation_review, consistency_review, retest_review, review_comments, confidence, human_escalation, and traceability.
entries.action: Assemble output matching output_schema.json. Validate before returning.

entries.title: Review Taxonomy v1.0 — 10 taxonomy codes
entries.description: The review taxonomy defines 10 codes for categorizing review comments: COMP (Completeness), EVID (Evidence), CLASS (Classification), SEV (Severity), CVSS (CVSS Review), CWE (CWE Review), IMP (Impact), REC (Recommendation), RET (Retest), and CONF (Confidence). Plus consistency rules.
entries.action: Assign taxonomy code to every review comment. Use format {CODE}-{NNN} (e.g., SEV-001).

entries.title: KB Entry Schema v1.1 — Knowledge Base entry structure
entries.description: The KB entry schema defines the structure of every Knowledge Base entry. Fields: kb_id, category, subcategory, title, description, conditions, action, references, severity, applicable_to, version, source, tags. New in v1.1 (per task 08/08 Definition of Done, PDF §3.3): document_type, section, vulnerability_type, effective_date, access_scope, source_id. Defined in src/harness/kb/schema.py.
entries.action: Validate every KB entry against this schema. Reject entries with invalid category or severity.
